title: Why Iman Gadzhi Never Made Anyone Rich
summary: Follow-the-money breakdown of a social media marketing agency guru: course and software income, low student success rates, and a saturated model.

assertions.quote: About 75 to 85% of Aman's wealth comes from teaching people how to do something he doesn't do anymore.
Iman doesn't publish any success rates. None. Zero.

verdicts.note: Course sellers' own disclaimers state they do not track customer results.

assertions.quote: Only 10 to 20% of students ever sign even one paying client.
His own students are competing against each other using the exact same scripts, the exact same tactics, the exact same pitch.

verdicts.note: Some agencies add strategy and accountability, but a reseller with no delivery skill competes against direct freelancer platforms.

assertions.quote: That's not passive income. That's not laptop lifestyle. That's a treadmill disguised as freedom.
They had business experience before. They had friends or connections they could call. They worked 40 plus hours a week on this.

verdicts.note: Consistent with success-story patterns, but based on anecdotal reviews.
